text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Copano Rickey put on quite 
an impressive performance.

Irreplaceable companions forged through 
racing. Now, those bonds take on a new 
form and spring into motion.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Rickey-chan, are you ready? Here 
we gooo☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Right, Falco-san! Ready, set!

text_block_list.name: Rickey & Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We are the idol unit, "Four Divine Beasts 
[Tetra Mystiques]"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, perfect♪ Let's keep this momentum 
going, all four of us!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um, Falco-san. Never mind Falco-san and 
me, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Are you and Acute-san going to become 
idols too, Ricky?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Idols... Personally, I only ever watched 
them on TV at the end of the year, though.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I figured that to get people hyped about 
dirt, running wasn't enough—promo stuff 
like this is important too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rickey-chan?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Plus, my lucky number was 4! I 
thought it'd be good to help bring us all 
closer to our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see. And what about the name 'Tetra 
Mystiques'?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the Four Auspicious Beasts in 
feng shui, I thought each one suited you 
guys perfectly! First off—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The Vermilion Bird herself, Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Vroom-zoom ☆ That's right, I'm a Falcon, 
so a bird is a perfect fit for me ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next, representing the Black Tortoise, 
Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Genbu is a turtle, right? Why am I the 
turtle?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um, the 'Hokko' in Tarumae means 'Northern 
Fortune'... So basically, north, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"In the world of feng shui, the Black 
Tortoise is the sacred beast guarding the 
north. So Tarumae is the Black Tortoise!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see... Come to think of it, I was raised 
in Hokkaido, so taking things one step at 
a time might be just my style.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And representing the White Tiger is Wonder 
Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Byakko? Like a tiger?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! "Acute" means sharp, so I thought 
maybe a white tiger with sharp claws.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Sounds like those hidden claws are 
ready to strike. *Shing!*

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And last of all! Representing the Azure 
Dragon is me, Copano Rickey☆ Let's do our 
best, the four of us!

The role fits her perfectly. All that's 
left is to polish the performance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! And with that, let's try a 
dance appeal!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go first, here I gooo! With that 
special choreo I made for Rickey-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go Go-âª Love Love-âª Let's do this-âª 
Hai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm next! After all, I'm a local idol!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Go Go-âª Love Love-âª Let's do this-âª 
Hai!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Tarumae, that was so good! But I'm 
not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Go Go-âª Love Love-âª Let's do this-âª 
Hai!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Last up is me, huh. Ready, set—!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Boom-chiki♪ Boom-chiki♪ Boom-chiki♪ 
Boom-chiki...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, feels like something's a bit off?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, Acute-san! You're always 
teaching me how to run, so now it's my 
turn to teach you!

And so, the "Tetra Mystiques" successfully 
made their debut. And then—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is it! This is where our challenge 
begins! The goal for the four of us is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To spread Feng Shui more and more to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, Rickey. The goal is to pack 
Tomakomai Civic Hall (the Main Hall) to 
capacity!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hae~, isn't the goal for everyone to get 
along and eat rice crackers together~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... Isn't this supposed to be a solo 
fest or something~? Everyone's doing their 
own thing~. Ricky-chan, let's match up~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, in times like these, the compass! The 
path we should take is—
And the direction pointed out was—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the one standing in the auspicious 
direction is Trainer! Which means...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So you're leaving not just the training, 
but the whole producing direction to me, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see... Guiding Rickey this far really 
was quite an impressive feat.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, she really is a promising 
youngster.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. Having people watching from 
off-stage is absolutely necessary too! 
That being the case—”

text_block_list.name: Rickey & Falcon
text_block_list.text: Please produce me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Acute
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer!

—Another job has been added to my plate. 
Even so, this too is—

To boost Copano Rickey and her companions 
even further, we must unite with everyone 
and dedicate ourselves to advancing the 
dirt division.
